name: uniform_discretize
title: Uniformly discretize a continuous distribution

args.name: n
args.description: The number of bins in the discretization

description: Approximate a continuous distribution by a discrete distribution with n equally weighted values. Divide the probability range into n equal bins and use the midpoint quantile of each bin: (i + 0.5)/n for i = 0,...,n-1. The values need not be equally spaced.
